atoms.text: Hi, I am Arthur. I am a boarder. I go to Ashford International School which is a boarding school in the South of England. At our school we have everything that we need. Our school not only provides places to study and eat, but also to play and sleep.

atoms.a: Does Arthur go to day school?
What does Ashford International School provide their boarders?

instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: Some of my classmates live at home and only go to day school. But as a boarder I can stay at boarding school and live with my friends. All boarders sleep in dorms. There are seperate dorms for boys and girls. They are near the school building. And each dorm has their own houseparent. While boys have a housemaster, girls have a housemistress. They care for us and supervise us. If you need advice, you can talk to them.

instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: After 8 hours of lessons like maths, history and chemistry, we get time to do the things we like the most. There are many different extracurricular activities we can choose from. We can join a language club, a sports club, a science club or an art club. Right now I am into sports, therefore, I have joined the basketball club. And in the next term I want to try out the cricket club. It never gets boring. Afterwards, we are free to do anything we want. I like to listen to music and watch films with my friends.

atoms.a: Which sport does he practise this term?
What does he do in his free time?
b: He plays basketball with his sister.
He sings in the school band.

instruction.text: Lies den Text und entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

atoms.text: Nevertheless, it's not just sunshine and roses. We have rules here too. We have to get up at 7 a.m. Everyone has to go to their own room and be quiet at 9 p.m. One hour later we have to go to bed. And once a week we have to clean our rooms.
atoms.sound: ssml: Nevertheless, it's not just sunshine and roses. We have rules here too. We have to get up at 7 a.m. <break time='800ms'/> Everyone has to go to their own room and be quiet at 9 p.m. <break time='800ms'/> One hour later we have to go to bed. And once a week we have to clean our rooms.

atoms.a: There are no rules at boarding school.
He has to clean his room every single day.
It is compulsory for boarders to be quiet after 9 p.m. and go to bed at 10 p.m.

instruction.text: Lies den Text und entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

atoms.text: There are things that are the same for all pupils, whether they go to day school or boarding school. Firstly, nearly all pupils in the UK have to wear school uniforms. Secondly, all pupils go on school trips. Additionally, every school has a headmaster or headmistress.

atoms.a: Only boarders go on school trips.
Only pupils that go to day school have to wear school uniforms.
Boarding schools don't have a headmaster or headmistress.
